summary: Iteration 23 — Waitlist 'Haber Ver' + launch notify + launch discount auto-apply. Backend: 15/15 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration23.py. POST /api/courses/<id>/notify validates email format (400 on invalid), creates waitlist entries with $setOnInsert dedupe (duplicate submit returns ok=true but DB stays at 1 row). GET /api/admin/waitlist returns rows with course_title join and supports course_id/status(pending|notified)/search filters. GET /api/admin/courses/<id>/waitlist/summary returns {pending,total}. Launch flow: PUT /api/admin/courses/<id> persists launch_discount_code (uppercased on save by frontend). POST /api/admin/courses/<id>/waitlist/notify returns 400 when course sale_closed OR unpublished OR launch_discount_code is restricted to another course. With open+published sale and valid code, notify queues all pending entries (queued=3, code=TESTWL*), after ~3s sleep all 3 rows have notified_at set and notified_code==code. Second notify with emails=[] queues 0 (idempotent). Resend with emails=[one] queues 1. Email templates waitlist_joined & course_launch exist in GET /api/admin/email-templates and course_launch.html contains {{discount_block}}. Course restore verified: sale_closed=False, launch_discount_code='', is_published=True returned to original state. Frontend (admin logged in): /yonetim/haber-ver-listesi renders admin-waitlist-page with filters waitlist-search/waitlist-course-filter/waitlist-status-filter and waitlist-page-export; after seeding one entry it renders waitlist-row-<email> with status badge Bekliyor and resend button. /yonetim/kurslar/<id> CourseEditor shows course-launch-code select with options including codes. Popup: with sale_closed=true + 1 pending entry, toggling course-sale-closed OFF and clicking save-course opens launch-notify-dialog showing launch-pending-count='1 kişiye' + launch-code-info. launch-cancel-btn closes dialog without saving. launch-skip-btn saves (navigates back to /yonetim/kurslar) with sale_closed flipped to false and waitlist entries remaining pending (notified_at null). CourseDetail /kurslar/<slug>?kod=CODE sets localStorage.pending_discount_code=CODE on load. Cleanup: 7 total test waitlist entries (resend.dev addresses) deleted post-run, TEST discount codes removed, test course state restored.

minor.issue: Requires authenticated session via get_current_user. Guest checkout users triggered via Checkout.jsx auto-apply (pending_discount_code) will hit 401 and the .catch(() => {}) silently swallows the error — the launch discount is NOT auto-applied for guests. Consider using get_optional_user so guest subtotal validation works.

action_items: (Optional) Allow /api/payments/validate-discount for guests (switch get_current_user -> get_optional_user) so launch-code auto-apply works before guest finishes customer form on /odeme.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_waitlist.notify_waitlist uses asyncio.create_task(_send_launch(...)) for non-blocking email sends — spec-matching (≈0.6s per entry). Entries become notified_at+notified_code only after each email send succeeds. Good.

routes_waitlist.launch_code_info correctly checks presence/active/course_ids restriction/usage_limit. Note: the check `(d.get('course_ids') or d.get('group_ids')) and course['course_id'] not in (d.get('course_ids') or [])` correctly rejects a code restricted to groups only (group_ids truthy, course_ids empty) — fine.
routes_courses.course_notify uses $setOnInsert for dedupe; `send_joined` only fires on first insert (res.upserted_id check). Good.
routes_payments.validate_discount requires get_current_user — this breaks guest auto-apply from Checkout.jsx (silently caught). Suggest get_optional_user.
AdminWaitlist.jsx CSV export is simple and includes BOM (\ufeff) + semicolon delimiter for Excel-TR. OK.
LaunchNotifyDialog shows pending count + conditional code info; onCancel also closes on backdrop (open={!!launch} + onOpenChange={(v)=>!v && onCancel()}). Good.

CourseEditor.save flow: pre-save check runs only when `!isNew && origSaleClosed && !form.sale_closed && form.is_published` and summary.pending>0 — correct per spec. If API call fails it silently continues to doSave which is defensive.
React hydration warning in console: <span data-ve-dynamic> injected inside <option> by dev tooling — editor instrumentation artifact, not a real bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin waitlist page, course editor launch code + sale_closed popup Vazgeç/Göndermeden Kaydet, ?kod localStorage)
